build.native: Both Rust SDKs use Bazel -c opt and SDK-scoped cross-crate ThinLTO; both C++ consumers Release -O3.
build.comparator: Pinned upstream release, opt-level=z, full LTO, one codegen unit. Bootstrap/workloads compiled with Hermes -O.
build.clock: Same high-resolution steady_clock __now() hook; full TS suite also uses __now().

benchmarkScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
bootstrap="$PWD/$(rg '\.hbc$' /tmp/hermes-plural-magrinj-bytecode-path)"
run_variant() {
 case "$1" in
  before) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-list-short-loop-hires "$2" ;;
  after) taskset -c 0 /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires "$2" ;;
  magrinj) FORMATJS_BENCH_BOOTSTRAP="$bootstrap" taskset -c 0 /tmp/hi-host-optimized "$2" ;;
 esac
}
run_case() {
 local label="$1" workload="$2"
 for variant in $variants; do
  run_variant "$variant" "$workload" > "/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-${label:+$label-}$variant-$round.jsonl"
 done
}
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case '' /tmp/hermes-list-default-overlap.hbc
 run_case tag /tmp/hermes-canonical-control.hbc
 run_case size /tmp/hermes-list-size-control.hbc
 run_case locale /tmp/hermes-canonical-locale-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case constructor /tmp/hermes-list-constructor-control.hbc
 run_case relative /tmp/hermes-rtf-bridge-control.hbc
done
for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='after before'; else variants='before after'; fi
 run_case full /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-all-api.hbc
done

for round in 1 2 3; do
 if [ "$round" = 2 ]; then variants='magrinj after before'; else variants='before after magrinj'; fi
 run_case boundary /tmp/hermes-list-short-boundary-control.js
done
profileScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
sdk=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-locale-inline-hires
host=/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires
for smoke in "$sdk"/js/*-smoke.js; do
 case "$smoke" in *datetimeformat-smoke.js) "$host" /tmp/hermes-list-default-datetime-smoke.js ;; *) "$host" "$smoke" ;; esac
done
"$host" /tmp/hermes-locale-extension-sdk-check.js > /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-sdk-extension-check.json
for variant in before after; do
 if [ "$variant" = before ]; then host=/tmp/hermes-list-short-loop-hires; else host=/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires; fi
 for round in 1 2 3; do
  taskset -c 0 "$host" -sample-profiling=chrome -sample-profiling-freq=1000 -profiling-out="/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-cold-$variant-$round.cpuprofile" /tmp/hermes-cold-locale-profile.js > "/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-cold-$variant-$round-profile.log" 2>&1
 done
 "$host" /tmp/hermes-benchmark-clock-check.js > "/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-clock-$variant.json"
done
bash /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-run.sh
consumerBuildScript:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp/hermes-intl-extension
PATH=/tmp/hermes-tools:$PATH bazel cquery -c opt //native/hermes/package:sdk --output=files > /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires-sdk-path 2>/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires-query.log
sdk_dir=/tmp/hermes-extension-sdk-locale-inline-hires
mkdir -p "$sdk_dir"
tar -xf "$(cat /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires-sdk-path)" -C "$sdk_dir"
# SDK tar timestamps are reproducible; refresh archive times for this CMake consumer.
find "$sdk_dir" -name '*.a' -exec touch {} +
cp "$sdk_dir"/contrib/[34][0-9]-*.js "$sdk_dir"/contrib/FormatJSIntl.cpp "$sdk_dir"/contrib/FormatJSIntl.h /tmp/hermes-extension-host/API/hermes/extensions/contrib/
cmake -S /tmp/hermes-extension-host -B /tmp/hermes-extension-build -DFORMATJS_HERMES_SDK="$sdk_dir" >/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires-cmake.log 2>&1
cmake --build /tmp/hermes-extension-build --target hermes -j8 >>/tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires-cmake.log 2>&1
cp /tmp/hermes-extension-build/bin/hermes /tmp/hermes-locale-inline-hires

order: Three CPU-0-pinned rounds; before/after/magrinj in rounds 1 and 3, reverse in round 2. Full 14-case native/TS suite uses three before/after rounds, reverse in round 2. Source boundary controls follow on all hosts in the same order. Profiles finish before timing; no builds or profiles overlap timing.
change: Rust language/script/region use TinyAsciiStr<8/4/3>; extension identifiers use one ASCII byte. Public strings, validation and the JS/C++ factory remain unchanged. Unicode option rebuilding now keeps private use last in Rust; TS inserts a new Unicode extension before private use. Twelve constructor-update cases match independent pinned ICU4C/J/X outputs.
